theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α K : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (R : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < α → 0 ≤ K → Tendsto R atTop atTop → (∀ k, f k 0 = 0) → (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ∀ z' ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (R k), ‖f k z - f k z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (V : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), StrictMono φ ∧ V 0 = 0 ∧ Continuous V ∧ (∀ z z' : Rn n, ‖V z - V z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn (fun j => f (φ j)) V atTop (closedBall (0 : Rn n) r)
